_comment: TW-13 coaching KB content half. Cross-links OKF strategies; numbers live in params.json (mostly unverified hypotheses until live confirm).

strategies.title: Pair trade loops
strategies.what: Cycle complementary ports: buy low at A, sell/buy at B, return. Rank by credits-per-turn, not credits-per-trip.
tradeoffs: Smaller faster loops can beat fatter slow ones.
Stock depletes — loops are not infinite.
Haggle is a per-trade overlay, not a property of the loop.
steps: Identify a nearby complementary port from the world-model.
Estimate turns/cycle (warps × turns-per-warp + trade time).
Rank candidates by cr/turn; prefer adjacent pairs.
Run until remaining-trades prediction says rotate.

strategies.title: Rotate before decay
strategies.what: Estimate remaining profitable trades from stock ÷ holds; leave before margin collapses. Ports may regrow — revisit later.
tradeoffs: Abandoning too early wastes setup turns.
Staying too late burns turns for crumbs.
Very large aggregate stock can signal plague risk (hypothesis).
steps: Read buy/sell stock fields for the active commodities.
remaining ≈ min(stock fields) ÷ current holds.
If below rotate_threshold_trades, hunt a fresh pair/chain.
Schedule a revisit after regrowth_window if the pair was strong.

strategies.title: Hide a planet in a dead-end
strategies.what: Single-exit sectors are strong defend/hide spots for a private planet once genesis is on the table.
tradeoffs: Genesis + defense is a real credit/turn commit — coach, don't auto-fire.
A dead-end with heavy traffic is not private.
steps: Confirm the sector has exactly one warp.
Note fighters/mines on approach from the world-model.
Surface as a genesis/hide candidate; wait for operator confirm.

strategies.title: Toll / gate combat math
strategies.what: Decide attack vs pay vs reroute from fighter odds and surrender ratios. Attack is NOT free — expect fighter losses.
tradeoffs: Reroute (~1 turn) is often cheaper than a fight.
Shields absorb more efficiently than buying fighters at rack.
Auto-engage is forbidden without explicit operator call (anti-PK).
steps: Estimate fighters needed ≈ (enemyFtr × enemyOdds) ÷ yourOdds.
Check shield cushion (~10% of fighters as a starting heuristic).
Compare expected fighter loss vs reroute turn cost.
Coach the options; never auto-attack players.

strategies.title: Planet production compounder
strategies.what: Planets make turn-free compounding income; cargo left on-planet can raise daily production. Best lever on no-PvP builder games.
strategies.status_note: No live tip path emits when_trigger=planet_management (coach_engine.infer_coach_triggers). Authored content retained; do not treat as wired. See coaching-engine.md Authored but unreachable + WO-CLEANUP-COACHING-STRATEGIES-JSON-UNREACHABLE-CARD.
tradeoffs: Mega-planets invite plague risk — diversify (hypothesis).
Buying production with credits only pays when unit price is cheap enough.
Equipment→planet→high-buyer dump loop needs relocation turns.
steps: Prefer many mid planets over one mega-planet.
When equipment is cheap, mass-transfer to planet before relocating beside a buyer.
Track productivity; spread load if approaching plague band.

strategies.title: Holds-first ship progression
strategies.what: Prioritize cargo capacity, then shields, then fighters. Rush a danger/density scanner early.
tradeoffs: Bigger holds without a sustaining loop stock depletes ports faster.
Upgrading late in a turn-capped run may not amortize (see TW-30).
Ship numbers are per-server — read game_data, never stock constants.
steps: Look up max-holds / cost from introspected game_data.
Run TW-30 upgrade decision against remaining turns + loop economics.
If recommend=false, coach HOLD with the rationale flags.

strategies.title: Celebrate longest profit chains
strategies.what: Multi-hop adjacent station cycles where every hop margins positive; call out length + cr/turn (TW-21).
tradeoffs: Longer is preferred, but cr/turn still breaks ties.
Needs a filled warp+port world-model to fire live.
steps: Run find_profit_chains + rank_chains on the graph.
Surface format_coach_callout to the Decisions box.
Optionally arm as a library row (source=discovered).

strategies.title: Density-scan before stepping
strategies.what: Scan adjacent sectors to prioritize visits; turn-free force-multiplier for mapping.
tradeoffs: Scan signatures are hypothesized mappings — verify vs live.
Does not replace visiting sectors that must be mapped for nav.
steps: If a density scanner is mounted, scan unknown adjacents first.
Visit high-value signatures next (ports, specials).
Write findings into the world-model.
